reason: Effective grants, tenancy, seats, revocation, sessions, and audit are application-authority rules; provider claims and content-family metadata do not select another implementation.
Opaque session creation, expiry, linking, revocation, and provider-token isolation vary by identity protocol, never by content engine.
Refresh persists provenance, releases, conflicts, and local-scan facts generically; family and confidence are values in those records.
Selection and readiness use a generic map keyed by registered adapter identifiers; the selected profile is data, not a family branch.
designFinding: The scenario looks family-shaped because it carries engine_profile, but multiplying selection cells would test the same ranking and ambiguity algorithm repeatedly.

reason: The normalized bundle and completeness law are shared, but archive parsing, paired-store resolution, bytecode references, and unit construction materially differ by family.
designFinding: Normalization, completeness accounting, and reversible source links belong in one shared conformance layer even though codecs remain family-owned.

reason: Readiness is a non-compensating decision over evidence dimensions and stable improvement lineage; a release profile labels the candidate but does not change the gate.
Alignment, privacy, locked splits, dimensions, calibration, and fair comparison are one methodology; engine family is corpus metadata.
designFinding: A benchmark reference and production-family rows look engine-specific, but they must pass one shared methodology rather than acquire separate comparison implementations.

reason: Concrete producers emit different traces, images, and fallback observations, so each production family needs its own capture proof even though containment and completeness are shared.
designFinding: Managed-root containment, redaction, evidence roles, and completeness should be proven once around the family capture producer.

reason: Publication branches on visibility, artifact kind, retention, hash, and authority; the producer family does not change safe resolution or redaction semantics.
designFinding: The feature carries engine_family as provenance, but publication should remain a single artifact-policy implementation.

reason: Authorization, play-receipt binding, hashing, and archive delivery are shared, but source-compatible patch byte production delegates to materially different family adapters.
designFinding: Keep the common played-receipt and delivery archive substrate out of family implementations; only byte production and its proof vary.

reason: The journey composes real decode, patch, replay, render, review, and played export for an exact family; those executable legs and receipts differ by production adapter.
designFinding: Onboarding, custody, review authority, and orchestration remain shared even though the composed family observation must be repeated.

reason: The Wiki maintains normalized facts, citations, scope, and immutable snapshots; decode evidence is upstream input rather than an alternate Wiki implementation.
Frozen ground truth derives from normalized facts, route and locale scope, and accepted rendering versions without a family dispatch.
Exact and fuzzy reuse rank and refuse on project, branch, locale, source, and authority compatibility; family metadata does not select another retrieval algorithm.
Reference rewriting, scene encoding, text-pool rebuilds, and family preflights materially differ, while every canonical role has an explicit positive or bounded outcome.
designFinding: Atomic preflight, stage, verify, promote, no-op, and safe-output rules are engine-neutral and should be shared rather than reimplemented.

reason: Portable URI, hash, immutability, authorization, and retention rules depend on artifact and privacy class, not the producing family.
Install, initialize, font, update, rollback, and installed-command behavior is a host and package lifecycle with no content-family implementation axis.
designFinding: The current doctor fixture embeds one family command grammar; that probe should be registry-driven rather than create family lifecycle cells.

reason: Placement, configuration source, secret source, precedence, and fail-loud startup define one closed deployment boundary independent of engine.
Leases, restart recovery, once-only completion, and uncertainty apply to every durable operation; the tracker explicitly has no engine knowledge.
A shared registry owns bridge, delta, API, and database version meaning; format kind and version vary, not engine implementation.
Choice, page-boundary, input, snapshot, save, and seek semantics are currently port-owned and materially differ across production families.
designFinding: Clock, event log, snapshot envelope, source binding, and mismatch rejection should move behind one typed shared control contract.

reason: Scene targets, labels, menus, and available branch actions differ by production runtime, and the common port currently refuses discovery.
designFinding: Traversal scheduling, loop bounds, and coverage accounting should become invariant after the port exposes typed branch enumeration and actions.

reason: Native replay construction, script execution, browser delegation, and bounded refusal differ by family, and every canonical role has an explicit launch outcome.
designFinding: Exact patch/source binding, status, diagnostic, and redaction belong in a shared launch envelope.

reason: Text windows, rendered frames, audio, browser text, and family equivalence rules require different production ports; sink ordering and validation are shared.
designFinding: Do not duplicate the typed sink contract or observation ordering in family implementations.

reason: Disclosure decisions branch on classification, permission, reveal intent, hash, derivative state, and revocation, never on engine.
Branch policy operates on normalized surfaces, capabilities, conflicts, and persisted settings; family facts are inputs to one policy algorithm.
designFinding: The surface/profile vocabulary looks engine-shaped, but policy must remain registry-driven and shared.

reason: Project, branch, source revision, locale, idempotency, and isolation form a generic persisted lineage; the project engine binding is merely retained state.
Managed relative references, content hashes, privacy class, and fresh-environment resolution are one evidence discipline regardless of producer family.
Operations and entrypoints feed one stable failure taxonomy and no-effect contract; family-originated diagnostics must normalize rather than create cells.
designFinding: Adapter-specific error types should map into the shared explicit-failure predicate instead of multiplying this behavior by family.

reason: Authority revalidation, transactionality, one valid winner, and rollback are application commit rules; engine data cannot alter them.
Field inventories and legitimate absence differ by executable source profile, so every production family cell must aggregate exact per-profile populated and total counts.
designFinding: The reporting schema and gap taxonomy are shared; only profile-owned field availability and measurements vary.

reason: Placement, provider posture, storage, retention, egress, and publication form one privacy contract independent of family.
designFinding: Family path and key probes should feed the shared privacy predicate, not create private-boundary cells.

reason: Byte equality, semantic equivalence, archive repack, transport, snapshot, and mutation cones depend on concrete container and execution profiles.
designFinding: Determinism, mutation isolation, and corruption detection remain shared laws even when each profile supplies a different comparator.

reason: Archive expansion, protected spans, container corruption, snapshot versions, size envelopes, and helper boundaries are concrete profile hazards.
designFinding: Hash, containment, no-effect, and typed refusal are shared; profile fuzzers supply the differing hazardous inputs.

reason: The comparison joins immutable parent, feedback, context, cost, observation, and artifact lineage using normalized identities without family branches.
The review UI and lineage are shared, but proving the started session consumed exact patched bytes crosses family-specific artifact layouts, descriptors, arguments, and receipts.
designFinding: Factor common UI and immutable play-receipt validation once; only launcher registration and exact-byte observation vary.

reason: Feedback addresses normalized project, branch, scene, moment, and successor lineage; current per-unit editing is a boundary defect, not an engine axis.
designFinding: Remove the per-unit mutation path while keeping whole-round feedback and successor creation engine-neutral.

reason: Requested and served provider identity, calls, tokens, latency, privacy posture, retry, and exact cost are one model-attempt ledger independent of engine.
Locale, run mode, provider, privacy, budget, and authority are admitted by one policy gate before content work.
Leases, pause, cancel, concurrency, isolation, progress, and cost belong to the generic durable run tracker.
Persisted counts, blockers, next actions, costs, status, and notifications are generic configured-scope read models.
The agent and quality loop is common, but the behavior requires mechanically valid produced patch content through family-owned byte apply, source discovery, scopes, and native arguments.
designFinding: Keep drafting, repair, coverage, and accepted-output logic shared; repeat only the production-family encoding and patch composition proof.

reason: Plain, encrypted, helper-required, misleading, missing-key, mixed-source, container, crypto, and codec states are the material implementation axes.
designFinding: Bundle preparation by registered access and materialization profile; family detectors should feed the shared layered-access model.

reason: Navigation, pagination, stable addressing, search, and authority are account, project, and locale concerns; engine is display and read-model data.
One schema and validator process data-driven capability tuples for every row; family values change the report data, not the behavior implementation.
designFinding: The 47-row Examples table should execute inside one shared disclosure cell; incomplete registry data is a defect, not 47 disclosure implementations.

reason: Qualification evidence and admissible operations differ for concrete profiles within a family, and the Gherkin declares a bounded outcome for every canonical role.
designFinding: Qualification validation is shared; each family cell aggregates every registered material profile rather than inventing cells from generic profile labels.

reason: Command, HTTP, and rendered entrypoints drive one injected workflow and one adapter interface; family options are registry data.
designFinding: Generate parity cases from capabilities instead of maintaining family-specific entrypoint specs.
